observation.command:
cat /tmp/fa.sh | head -5; echo "==="; B64=$(cat <<'PY' | base64 -w0
#!/bin/bash
cd /workspace
eval $(grep -E "^(LOCAL_USER_EMAIL|LOCAL_USER_PASSWORD)=" .env | sed "s/^/export /")
JAR=/tmp/fa-cookies.txt; OUT=/tmp/fa.out; : > $OUT; rm -f "$JAR"
loc=$(curl -sS -c $JAR -o /dev/null -w "%{redirect_url}" "http://localhost:3000/app/" 2>>$OUT)
echo "step1=$loc" >> $OUT
[ -z "$loc" ] && { echo FAIL-redirect >> $OUT; cat $OUT; exit 1; }
code=$(curl -sS -b $JAR -c $JAR -o /tmp/fa-login.html -w "%{http_code}" "$loc" 2>>$OUT)
echo "step2=$code" >> $OUT
ACTION=$(grep -oE "<form id=\"kc-form-login\"[^>]*action=\"[^\"]*\"" /tmp/fa-login.html | sed "s/.*action=\"//;s/\"$//;s/&/\\&/g")
res=$(curl -sS -b $JAR -c $JAR -o /tmp/fa-login2.html -w "%{http_code}|%{redirect_url}" -X POST "$ACTION" --data-urlencode "username=$LOCAL_USER_EMAIL" --data-urlencode "password=$LOCAL_USER_PASSWORD" --data-urlencode "signup=false" 2>>$OUT)
echo "step3=$res" >> $OUT
CB=$(echo "$res" | cut -d"|" -f2)
res4=$(curl -sS -b $JAR -c $JAR -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}|%{redirect_url}" "$CB" 2>>$OUT)
echo "step4=$res4" >> $OUT
APP=$(echo "$res4" | cut -d"|" -f2)
code5=$(curl -sS -b $JAR -c $JAR -o /tmp/fa-app.html -w "%{http_code}" "$APP" 2>>$OUT)
echo "step5=$code5" >> $OUT
echo "title=$(grep -oE "<title>[^<]*" /tmp/fa-app.html | head -1)" >> $OUT
cat $OUT
PY
)
echo "$B64" | base64 -d > /tmp/fa2.sh && chmod +x /tmp/fa2.sh && wc -l /tmp/fa2.sh && diff <(head -3 /tmp/fa2.sh) <(printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/bash' 'cd /workspace' 'eval $(grep -E "^(LOCAL_USER_EMAIL|LOCAL_USER_PASSWORD)=" .env | sed "s/^/export /")') && echo "VERIFY-OK"
